info.title: BigOLens.Cli
info.description: CLI for empirical Big O complexity analysis: runs [ComplexityBenchmark] methods at increasing input sizes, fits time and memory against complexity curves, and emits console + HTML reports.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: BigOLens — empirical Big O complexity analysis for .NET.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Measure [ComplexityBenchmark] methods at increasing input sizes and fit time + memory against Big O curves.

options.name: --assembly
options.description: Path to a built assembly (.dll) containing [ComplexityBenchmark] methods.

options.name: --project
options.description: Path to a .csproj; it is built in Release and its output assembly is used.

options.name: --output
options.description: Path for the self-contained HTML report. [default: bigolens-report.html]

options.name: --filter
options.description: Only run benchmarks whose method name or full id matches this wildcard pattern (* and ?).

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Stream BenchmarkDotNet's own log output. [default: False]
